trends.name: Iran Military Escalation & Market Risk
trends.summary: US conducting 50+ strikes on Iran's Kharg Island with Trump escalating threats; military commanders may refuse orders on civilian targets. S&P 500 down 0.5%, oil futures climbing as market prices in geopolitical risk. Strait of Hormuz shipping protection vetoed by China/Russia, threatening global energy supplies.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge on Middle East Conflict
trends.summary: EIA raises oil-price forecasts as Middle East conflict deepens; oil futures climbing on Iran strikes. Multiple headlines flagging war panic and oil volatility as critical market factor. Energy sector beneficiary but broader market headwind given inflationary implications.

trends.name: Stock Market Volatility & War Uncertainty
trends.summary: Equities selling off on Iran war uncertainty with Trump's Tuesday night deadline looming; S&P 500 down 0.5%. Historical data shows stocks bottom quickly once war breaks out, but current fog-of-war creating sustained selling pressure. Multiple analyst warnings on defensive positioning.

trends.name: AI Spending & Tech Earnings Expectations
trends.summary: Amazon analyst sees 50% upside as investors reassess AI spending thesis; Nvidia positioned for agentic-as-a-service macro shift. OpenAI leadership drama with Altman vs. Musk spat ongoing. AI capex cycle remains structural growth driver despite near-term geopolitical uncertainty.

trends.name: Durable Goods & Factory Orders Data
trends.summary: US factory orders for durable goods becoming focus as economic resilience indicator amid geopolitical stress. Weak manufacturing data could signal demand slowdown independent of war premium. Key macro indicator for Fed policy path.

trends.name: Emerging Markets & De-Dollarization Trends
trends.summary: Declining dollarization implications gaining attention; Pakistan FM notes setback to peace efforts and potential currency implications. AVES emerging markets ETF underperforming; geopolitical fragmentation favoring non-dollar assets. Structural macro shift accelerating.

trends.name: Consumer Staples & Beer Sales Recovery
trends.summary: Corona brewer stock rallying ahead of earnings on signs of improving beer sales; P&G turnaround strategy showing traction. Consumer spending resilience in discretionary categories despite inflation concerns. Defensive consumer play gaining momentum.

trends.name: Bank Earnings & Financial Sector Rotation
trends.summary: Citigroup approaching Q1 earnings with analyst bullish views; Sumitomo Mitsui maintaining bullish ROE targets. Financial sector positioning ahead of rate cycle clarity. Banking stocks beneficiary of higher for longer rates if geopolitical risk prevents Fed cuts.

trends.name: Cybersecurity & AI Safety Concerns
trends.summary: Anthropic limiting Mythos AI rollout over hacker exploitation fears; broader AI safety governance questions emerging. Regulatory overhang for AI companies; potential for stricter controls on model deployment. Risk to AI capex growth narrative.

trends.name: Semiconductor & Quantum Stock Valuations
trends.summary: Mizuho cuts targets on quantum stocks without fundamental optimism shift; Rambus strong $2.2B roadmap but awaiting lower entry. Semiconductor sector premium valuations facing pressure. Wait-and-see posture on quantum upside cycle timing.

trends.name: Real Estate & Mortgage Market Dynamics
trends.summary: IYRI active strategy outperforming passive real estate indexing (VNQ); VMBS mortgage bonds showing negative convexity tax. Real estate sector beneficiary of higher rates but with mixed performance across active/passive strategies. Repositioning underway.

trends.name: Trump Administration Policy & Market Sentiment
trends.summary: Trump praising Hungary PM Orbán; war threats and policy decisions creating uncertainty on international relations front. Administration foreign policy unpredictability feeding geopolitical risk premium. Markets pricing in continued volatility from policy decisions.
